items.workflowName: Support agent with MCP tools and memory
Support agent with MCP tools and memory

nodes.label: Schedule Trigger
nodes.description: Triggers workflow execution automatically from a cron schedule.

nodes.label: Webhook Input
nodes.description: Injects webhook payload into workflow context.

nodes.label: Text Input
nodes.description: Provides static input text for a workflow run.

nodes.label: System Prompt
nodes.description: Static system prompt node.

sampleConfig.text: You are an assistant that answers with concise factual output.

nodes.label: User Prompt
nodes.description: Static user prompt node.

nodes.label: Loop / ForEach
nodes.description: Iterates over an input array and executes direct downstream nodes once per item.

nodes.label: HTTP Request
nodes.description: Performs a configurable HTTP request with templated URL, headers, and body.

nodes.label: Merge / Join
nodes.description: Merges outputs from multiple parent branches after fan-in.

nodes.label: Execute Workflow
nodes.description: Executes another workflow as a reusable sub-workflow.

nodes.label: Wait / Delay
nodes.description: Pauses execution for a bounded amount of time before continuing.

resumeAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime string for datetime resume mode

nodes.label: Set / Transform
nodes.description: Builds a structured output object from key/template assignments.

nodes.label: Code Node
nodes.description: Runs custom JavaScript transformation logic in a sandboxed VM context.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.description: Builds a prompt using handlebars-style placeholders.

nodes.label: LLM Call
nodes.description: Executes a model completion call.

nodes.label: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls OpenAI chat models with an API key or OPENAI_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Anthropic Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls Anthropic Claude models with an API key or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls a local Ollama model through its OpenAI-compatible API.

nodes.label: OpenAI Compatible Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls any OpenAI-compatible chat API such as OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, or LM Studio.

nodes.label: AI Gateway Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls a corporate AI gateway using OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI, or Anthropic protocol.

nodes.label: Azure OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls Azure OpenAI chat/completions using deployment + API version.

nodes.label: Google Gemini Chat Model
nodes.description: Calls Google Gemini chat completions using an API key.

nodes.label: Embeddings Azure OpenAI
nodes.description: Generates embedding vectors using Azure OpenAI embedding deployments.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestrator
nodes.description: Runs iterative tool-aware agent loop.

nodes.label: Supervisor Node
nodes.description: Swarm Supervisor that coordinates attached Worker nodes.

nodes.label: Simple Memory
nodes.description: SQLite-backed session memory that can be attached to an Agent Orchestrator node.

nodes.label: Session Artifact Load
nodes.description: Loads an exact JSON artifact saved for the current session, such as a prior report payload.

nodes.label: Session Artifact Save
nodes.description: Saves an exact JSON artifact for the current session so later turns can reuse it deterministically.

nodes.label: Chat Intent Router
nodes.description: Routes helper-chat requests into report, code, message, or missing-context branches without custom Switch conditions.

sampleConfig.reportKeywords: report, pdf, dashboard, chart, analytics, summary, visualize
sampleConfig.codeKeywords: python, code, script, automate, nightly, regenerate, reproduce, without ai, without l2m

nodes.label: Helper Chat Response
nodes.description: Packages report HTML, code blocks, and file attachments into the response shape helper-chat understands.

nodes.label: MCP Tool
nodes.description: Directly invokes an MCP tool outside the agent loop.

nodes.label: RAG Retrieve
nodes.description: Retrieves context chunks from provided documents or vector store.

nodes.label: Web Browse
nodes.description: Drives a headless Chromium to fetch a URL, wait for JS, and extract structured page data: rendered HTML, page text, screenshot, title, meta tags, links, and images. Use when http_request can't see the page (SPAs, JS-rendered content) or when an LLM needs to reason about a page's actual look.

nodes.label: Chart
nodes.description: Renders a Vega-Lite chart spec to SVG (server-side, no browser). Pair with pdf_output for branded reports. The same spec format Altair / Streamlit / Observable / Vega Editor use, so an LLM can produce specs directly.

nodes.label: Extract Citations
nodes.description: Phase 9.4 — scans an LLM answer for [N] markers, resolves each to the upstream retrieved document, and emits structured citations the chat UI renders as clickable footnotes. Wire after llm_call when the upstream chain produced documents.

nodes.label: Rerank
nodes.description: Reorders candidate documents by relevance via a cross-encoder reranker (Cohere / Jina / Voyage). Plug after rag_retrieve for the precision boost.

credentials.label: Reranker API Key Secret
credentials.hint: Cohere, Jina or Voyage API key matching the provider. Optional when the server sets the provider's API key environment variable.

nodes.label: Document Chunker
nodes.description: Splits documents into smaller chunks for embeddings.

nodes.label: Connector Source
nodes.description: Fetches documents from a connector adapter.

nodes.label: Google Drive Source
nodes.description: Fetches Google Drive files as documents for RAG retrieval.

nodes.label: Azure Storage
nodes.description: Reads/writes Azure Blob Storage containers and blobs.

nodes.label: Azure Cosmos DB
nodes.description: Queries and mutates documents in Azure Cosmos DB containers.

nodes.label: Microsoft Azure Monitor
nodes.description: Queries Azure Monitor logs/metrics or executes authenticated monitor API requests.

nodes.label: Azure AI Search Vector Store
nodes.description: Runs vector and document operations against Azure AI Search indexes.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.description: Runs vector retrieval and document upsert operations against a Qdrant collection.

nodes.label: Output Parser
nodes.description: Validates and transforms LLM output into structured data using JSON Schema, item list parsing, or auto-fix retry.

nodes.label: Human Approval
nodes.description: Pauses execution and waits for a human approve/reject action before resuming.

sampleConfig.approvalMessage: Approve before sending this response to the customer?

nodes.label: Approval Gate
nodes.description: Pauses the run until an assigned approver approves (optionally editing listed fields) or rejects; routes to approved, rejected or timed_out.

sampleConfig.message: Approve this reply before it is sent?

nodes.label: Input Validator
nodes.description: Validates input fields against deterministic rules before downstream execution.

nodes.label: Output Guardrail
nodes.description: Validates and optionally retries model output when guardrail checks fail.

nodes.label: Guard
nodes.description: Checks content with a guard profile and routes it to pass, blocked or review instead of failing the run. Attached to an agent's guard port, it guards the agent loop.

nodes.label: Protection Provider
nodes.description: Tokenises, encrypts, hashes or masks sensitive data for a guard. Attach it to a guard node's protection port; keys come from the secret store.

nodes.label: Basic LLM Chain
nodes.description: Simple prompt-to-response chain with configurable system and user prompt templates.

nodes.label: Q&A Chain
nodes.description: Answers questions using provided context documents. Returns answer with source citations.

nodes.label: Summarization Chain
nodes.description: Summarizes input text with configurable length and style.

nodes.label: Information Extractor
nodes.description: Extracts structured information from text based on a configurable schema.

nodes.label: Text Classifier
nodes.description: Classifies input text into one of the configured categories.

nodes.label: Sentiment Analysis
nodes.description: Analyzes sentiment of input text. Returns sentiment label, confidence score, and explanation.

nodes.label: AI Transform
nodes.description: Transform data using natural language instructions. The LLM generates and applies a transformation based on your description.

sampleConfig.instruction: Convert this data to a markdown table

nodes.label: IF
nodes.description: Evaluates a condition and routes execution to the true or false branch.

nodes.label: Switch
nodes.description: Routes execution to one of several branches based on a matched value.

nodes.label: Try / Catch
nodes.description: Wraps downstream execution in a try/catch block. Routes to an error branch on failure.

nodes.label: PDF Output
nodes.description: Generates a downloadable PDF link from upstream content (plain text or HTML rendering).

nodes.label: Output
nodes.description: Formats final workflow output payload.

nodes.label: Sub-Workflow Trigger
nodes.description: Entry point for workflows invoked as sub-workflows via Execute Workflow node.

nodes.label: Error Trigger
nodes.description: Fires when a designated production workflow fails. Configure target workflows in their Error Workflow setting.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Evaluates conditions against context data and routes to pass or filtered branches.

nodes.label: Stop and Error
nodes.description: Immediately stops the workflow with a custom error message and code.

nodes.label: No Operation
nodes.description: Pass-through node that performs no operation. Useful as a placeholder or visual marker.

nodes.label: Aggregate
nodes.description: Groups items and aggregates a numeric/text field (sum, avg, min, max, count, concatenate).

nodes.label: Split Out
nodes.description: Splits an array field into multiple items.

nodes.label: Sort
nodes.description: Sorts items ascending, descending, randomly, or by custom expression.

nodes.label: Limit
nodes.description: Caps an array of items to N entries from the start or end.

nodes.label: Remove Duplicates
nodes.description: Removes duplicate items by all or specified fields.

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.description: Multi-field aggregate (pivot-like). Supports group-by and multiple aggregations per group.

nodes.label: Compare Datasets
nodes.description: Diffs two datasets by a key field and reports added/removed/changed/same items.

nodes.label: Rename Keys
nodes.description: Renames keys on items in an array (or single object).

nodes.label: Edit Fields
nodes.description: Adds, modifies, removes or renames fields on items.

nodes.label: Date & Time
nodes.description: Format, parse, add/subtract or compare dates using built-in Date and Intl.

nodes.label: Crypto
nodes.description: Hash, HMAC, encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify using node:crypto.

nodes.label: JWT
nodes.description: Sign, decode, verify JWTs (HS256/HS384/HS512). HMAC-only, no external library.

nodes.label: XML
nodes.description: Convert XML to JSON or JSON to XML using a built-in lightweight parser.

nodes.label: HTML
nodes.description: Extract data from HTML via simple CSS-like selectors, or generate HTML.

nodes.label: Convert to File
nodes.description: Convert data to CSV, JSON, HTML, or text file output.

nodes.label: Extract from File
nodes.description: Parse CSV, JSON, or XML strings/base64 into structured data.

nodes.label: Compression
nodes.description: Gzip / gunzip data using node:zlib. Zip/unzip not yet supported.

nodes.label: Edit Image
nodes.description: Image editing (resize/crop/rotate/text/watermark). Requires optional native dependency — currently not implemented in core.

nodes.label: Webhook Response
nodes.description: Overrides the outgoing webhook HTTP response (status, headers, and body).

nodes.label: Slack: Send Message
nodes.description: Post a message to a Slack channel via webhook or bot token.

nodes.label: Slack Trigger
nodes.description: Webhook-based trigger that validates Slack signing secret. Point Slack Events at /api/webhooks/slack/:workflowId.

nodes.label: SMTP: Send Email
nodes.description: Send email via SMTP (nodemailer).

nodes.label: IMAP Email Trigger
nodes.description: Poll an IMAP inbox for new messages (requires imapflow — stubbed if missing).

nodes.label: Google Sheets: Read
nodes.description: Read a range from a Google Sheet (OAuth access token or API key).

nodes.label: Google Sheets: Append
nodes.description: Append rows to a Google Sheet.

nodes.label: Google Sheets: Update
nodes.description: Update values in a Google Sheet range.

nodes.label: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.description: Polling trigger that detects new rows since the last run.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL: Query
nodes.description: Execute a SQL query against PostgreSQL and return rows.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Trigger
nodes.description: Polling trigger: execute a SELECT periodically and emit new rows.

sampleConfig.query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE created_at > NOW() - interval '1 minute'

nodes.label: MySQL: Query
nodes.description: Execute a SQL query against MySQL.

nodes.label: MongoDB: Operation
nodes.description: Perform find / insert / update / aggregate on MongoDB.

nodes.label: Redis: Command
nodes.description: Execute a Redis command (GET/SET/DEL/PUBLISH/LPUSH/RPUSH/HSET/HGET/EXPIRE).

nodes.label: Redis Trigger
nodes.description: Subscribe / blocking-pop trigger (polling fallback with BLPOP).

nodes.label: GitHub: Action
nodes.description: Execute a GitHub REST API operation (issues, PRs, files, commits).

nodes.label: GitHub Webhook Trigger
nodes.description: Webhook trigger that validates the X-Hub-Signature-256 header.

nodes.label: Manual Trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow manually from the editor or via POST /api/triggers/manual/:workflowId.

nodes.label: Form Trigger
nodes.description: Public HTML form that starts a workflow. GET /api/forms/:path renders the form, POST submits.

nodes.label: Chat Trigger
nodes.description: Receive chat messages via POST /api/chat/:workflowId. Pairs naturally with agent_orchestrator.

nodes.label: File Trigger
nodes.description: Watches a filesystem path (polling) and fires on created/modified/deleted files.

nodes.label: RSS / Atom Trigger
nodes.description: Poll an RSS or Atom feed and fire the workflow for new items (deduplicated by GUID).

nodes.label: SSE Trigger
nodes.description: Connects to a Server-Sent Events URL and fires the workflow for each event.

nodes.label: Expose as MCP Tool
nodes.description: Turn this workflow into an MCP tool that other agents (including other L2M agents) can invoke. Add the workflow to a toolset on the MCP servers page to serve it to MCP clients at /mcp/:toolset; the legacy REST routes GET /api/mcp-server/:path/manifest and POST /api/mcp-server/:path/invoke keep working. Downstream nodes receive the tool arguments as input.

sampleConfig.toolDescription: Answer a question using the knowledge base.

nodes.label: Kafka Trigger
nodes.description: Consume messages from a Kafka topic (requires 'kafkajs' — emits NOT_IMPLEMENTED if missing).

nodes.label: RabbitMQ Trigger
nodes.description: Consume messages from a RabbitMQ queue (requires 'amqplib' — emits NOT_IMPLEMENTED if missing).

nodes.label: Sticky Note
nodes.description: A visual-only annotation on the canvas (markdown supported). Not executed by the runtime.

sampleConfig.content:
## Note
Explain what this section of the workflow does.

nodes.label: MQTT Trigger
nodes.description: Subscribe to an MQTT topic (requires 'mqtt' — emits NOT_IMPLEMENTED if missing).

nodes.label: Microsoft Teams: Send Message
nodes.description: Post a card or text message to a Microsoft Teams channel via an incoming webhook.

credentials.label: Webhook URL Secret
credentials.hint: Secret whose value is the Teams incoming webhook URL. Only needed when Webhook URL is blank.

nodes.label: Notion: Create Page
nodes.description: Create a page in a Notion database using an integration token.

credentials.label: Notion Token Secret
credentials.hint: Notion internal integration token (secret_...).

nodes.label: Notion: Query Database
nodes.description: Query a Notion database with optional filter/sort JSON.

credentials.label: Notion Token Secret
credentials.hint: Notion internal integration token (secret_...).

nodes.label: Airtable: Create Record
nodes.description: Create one or more records in an Airtable table (personal access token).

credentials.label: Airtable Token Secret
credentials.hint: Airtable personal access token.

nodes.label: Airtable: List Records
nodes.description: List records from an Airtable table with optional formula + max page size.

credentials.label: Airtable Token Secret
credentials.hint: Airtable personal access token.

nodes.label: Airtable: Update Record
nodes.description: Patch an Airtable record by ID.

credentials.label: Airtable Token Secret
credentials.hint: Airtable personal access token.

nodes.label: Jira: Create Issue
nodes.description: Create a Jira Cloud issue. Auth via Atlassian API token (email:token basic auth stored in the secret).

credentials.label: Jira API Token Secret
credentials.hint: Atlassian API token, paired with the Email field for basic auth.

nodes.label: Jira: Search Issues
nodes.description: Run a JQL search against Jira Cloud.

credentials.label: Jira API Token Secret
credentials.hint: Atlassian API token, paired with the Email field for basic auth.

nodes.label: Salesforce: Create Record
nodes.description: Create a record on a Salesforce sObject. Auth via OAuth access token stored as a secret.

credentials.label: Salesforce Token Secret
credentials.hint: Salesforce OAuth access token.

nodes.label: Salesforce: SOQL Query
nodes.description: Run a SOQL query against Salesforce.

sampleConfig.soql: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10

credentials.label: Salesforce Token Secret
credentials.hint: Salesforce OAuth access token.

nodes.label: HubSpot: Create Contact
nodes.description: Create a HubSpot contact using a private app access token.

credentials.label: HubSpot Token Secret
credentials.hint: HubSpot private app access token.

nodes.label: HubSpot: Get Contact
nodes.description: Fetch a HubSpot contact by ID or email.

credentials.label: HubSpot Token Secret
credentials.hint: HubSpot private app access token.

nodes.label: Stripe: Create Customer
nodes.description: Create a Stripe customer. Secret must contain a restricted/private API key.

credentials.label: Stripe API Key Secret
credentials.hint: Stripe restricted or secret API key.

nodes.label: Stripe: Create PaymentIntent
nodes.description: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent (the modern replacement for Charges).

credentials.label: Stripe API Key Secret
credentials.hint: Stripe restricted or secret API key.

nodes.label: Stripe Webhook Trigger
nodes.description: Webhook-based trigger that validates Stripe signatures. Point Stripe at /api/webhooks/stripe/:workflowId.

credentials.label: Webhook Signing Secret
credentials.hint: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) used to verify incoming events.

nodes.label: AWS S3: Put Object
nodes.description: Upload an object to S3 via SigV4. Credentials secret stores JSON {accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken?}.

credentials.label: AWS Credentials Secret
credentials.hint: AWS credentials as JSON {accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken?} or 'accessKeyId:secretAccessKey'.

nodes.label: AWS S3: Get Object
nodes.description: Download an object from S3. Returns text for text/* and application/json, otherwise base64.

credentials.label: AWS Credentials Secret
credentials.hint: AWS credentials as JSON {accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken?} or 'accessKeyId:secretAccessKey'.

nodes.label: AWS S3: List Objects
nodes.description: List objects under a prefix via S3 ListObjectsV2.

credentials.label: AWS Credentials Secret
credentials.hint: AWS credentials as JSON {accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken?} or 'accessKeyId:secretAccessKey'.

nodes.label: Telegram: Send Message
nodes.description: Send a Telegram message via the Bot API. Secret stores the bot token.

credentials.label: Bot Token Secret
credentials.hint: Telegram bot token from BotFather.

nodes.label: Telegram Trigger
nodes.description: Webhook-based trigger validated by X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token. Point setWebhook at /api/webhooks/telegram/:workflowId.

credentials.label: Webhook Secret Token
credentials.hint: Value sent in X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token; incoming requests are verified against it.

nodes.label: Discord: Send Message
nodes.description: Send a message via a Discord webhook URL (or bot token).

credentials.label: Webhook URL Secret
credentials.hint: Secret whose value is the Discord webhook URL. Only needed when Webhook URL is blank.

nodes.label: Discord Trigger
nodes.description: Webhook-based trigger validated with Ed25519 signature (X-Signature-Ed25519 + X-Signature-Timestamp).

nodes.label: Google Drive Trigger
nodes.description: Poll a Google Drive folder for new or modified files using an access token.

credentials.label: Google Access Token Secret
credentials.hint: Google OAuth access token with Drive read scope.

nodes.label: Google Calendar: Create Event
nodes.description: Create a calendar event using an OAuth access token stored as a secret.

credentials.label: Google Access Token Secret
credentials.hint: Google OAuth access token with the Calendar events scope.

nodes.label: Google Calendar: List Events
nodes.description: List upcoming events from a Google Calendar.

credentials.label: Google Access Token Secret
credentials.hint: Google OAuth access token with Calendar read scope.

nodes.label: Twilio: Send SMS
nodes.description: Send an SMS via Twilio. Secret stores the auth token paired with the Account SID in config.

credentials.label: Twilio Auth Token Secret
credentials.hint: Twilio auth token that pairs with the Account SID field.

prefix.description: Prepended to the echoed user message. Default 'Echo: ' makes it obvious this is the demo provider, not a real LLM.

mcpServers.label: HTTP MCP Server
mcpServers.description: Connect to a remote MCP endpoint over HTTP streamable transport.

mcpServers.label: Stdio MCP Server
mcpServers.description: Connect to a local MCP server over stdio (spawns a child process and speaks JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout).

command.description: Executable command (e.g. 'npx', 'node', 'python3', or an absolute path).

args.description: Arguments passed to the command, e.g. ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem', '/data

env.description: Extra environment variables for the child process. Merged on top of the parent process env.

cwd.description: Working directory for the child process. Defaults to the parent process cwd.

secretEnvVar.description: Optional. If set together with an auth secretRef, the resolved secret is injected into the child env under this name (e.g. 'GITHUB_TOKEN').

timeoutMs.description: Per-RPC request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

secretRef.description: Optional. Combine with secretEnvVar to inject the resolved secret into the child process environment.

mcpServers.label: Mock MCP Server
mcpServers.description: Local demo MCP adapter with time, calculator, and KB tools.

mcpServers.label: Snapshot mock server
mcpServers.description: Offline stub generated from a registry server's accepted schema snapshot. Answers from a cassette when one is set, else from each tool's outputSchema.

sourceServerId.description: Registry server whose accepted snapshot the mock serves.

snapshot.description: An exported snapshot file, inline, instead of sourceServerId.

cassetteId.description: Optional cassette the mock answers tool calls from.

fixedText.description: Text result for tools with no outputSchema and no recording.

profiles.name: Default guard profile
profiles.description: Blocks injection and tool-argument attacks, strips hidden characters, redacts credentials and masks card numbers.

profiles.name: Strict intake
profiles.description: Blocks email addresses and redacts other sensitive data in prompts.

detectors.description: Instruction override, jailbreak personas, system-prompt extraction and encoded payloads in user input and model output.
Instructions planted in tool results, retrieved documents and other untrusted content: text that addresses the model, embedded tasks, hidden markup, planted tool calls.
Unicode tag characters, bidi overrides and zero-width runs that hide or reorder text.
Markdown images and links whose URLs carry data, and unexpected outbound URLs in tool arguments.
Canary tokens planted in the system prompt showing up in model output, tool arguments or the final answer.
Injection classifier (rule-based rule-pack); the rule pack stands in when no model is registered.
Email, phone, payment cards (Luhn), IBAN (mod-97), US SSN and other national ids, credentials, keys and custom dictionaries.
Parses SQL arguments per dialect; blocks stacked queries, tautologies and comment tricks; enforces table and column allowlists, WHERE on mutations and a row cap.
Shell metacharacters, command substitution, redirection, destructive commands and option-shaped arguments from untrusted input.
Static checks on code-node source: dangerous imports and calls for Python and JavaScript.
Resolves path arguments against allowed roots; blocks traversal and symlink escapes.
Checks URL arguments against an allowlist after DNS resolution; blocks private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses and redirects to them.
Strict validation of tool arguments against the tool's input schema, with size and depth limits.

presets.description: Read-only SQL access to a PostgreSQL database. Inspects schema and runs SELECT queries.
presets.notes: Replace the DSN with your database connection string. The server is read-only by design — it cannot mutate data.

presets.name: SQLite
presets.description: Query and inspect a local SQLite database file. Useful for exploring local data with an agent.
presets.notes: Replace '/path/to/database.db' with the absolute path to a SQLite file.

presets.name: Brave Search
presets.description: Run web and local search queries via the Brave Search API.

credentialHint.description: Get an API key from api.search.brave.com. The free tier is sufficient for casual use.

presets.name: Fetch
presets.description: Fetch arbitrary URLs and return Markdown-converted content. Good general-purpose web tool.

presets.name: Time
presets.description: Time and timezone conversion utilities. Lightweight, no credentials required.

presets.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
presets.description: A persistent knowledge graph the agent can read from and write to across sessions. Useful for long-term memory.

presets.name: Sequential Thinking
presets.description: Lets the agent break down a problem into a chain of explicit reasoning steps. Often improves multi-step reasoning quality.

presets.name: Puppeteer (Browser)
presets.description: Drive a headless Chrome browser. Navigate URLs, take screenshots, fill forms, and scrape JavaScript-heavy pages.
presets.notes: First run downloads Chromium (~150 MB). Subsequent runs reuse the cached browser.

presets.name: Slack
presets.description: Read channels and messages, post messages, and search Slack via a bot token. Great for ops and notification workflows.

credentialHint.description: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add bot scopes (channels:read, chat:write, etc.), install to your workspace, and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...). Replace the placeholder SLACK_TEAM_ID in env.
